zh: 名额限制只作用在原字符串的每个极大相同字符段内部，跳过命令不会改变段的划分，所以各段之间完全独立。
收益都是正数，每段在名额内能选就选；固定名额时选收益最大的若干项最优，所以每段取最大的 min(k, 段长) 个收益。
从左到右扫描，找到每个极大段 [start, i)；把这一段的收益降序排序（或部分选择前 k 大），累加前 k 个；全部段加完后用 64 位整数输出。
en: The limit applies inside each maximal run of identical characters of the original string, and skipping commands never changes the runs, so the runs are completely independent.

All profits are positive, so each run should use as many slots as it can; with a fixed number of slots, picking the largest profits is optimal, so each run contributes its min(k, run length) largest profits.
Scan left to right to find each maximal run [start, i); sort that run's profits in descending order (or select its top k) and add the first k; after all runs, print the total as a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Handle each original run independently and choose at most k items with the largest profits in that run.

## Proof of correctness

The slots of different runs do not affect each other, and since profits are positive, each run should take items whenever it can. With a fixed number of slots, if a lower profit were chosen while a higher one was left out, swapping them would improve the total, so taking the k largest items of each run is optimal, and summing them gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
